Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_EMSG3_AdcCapture_Ctrl_v1
Objects.description: EMSP G3 raw ADC capture request. Written only by the tool; the device reports in AdcCapture_Status

variables.name: armId
variables.description: Write a new non-zero value to (re)arm with the settings below; 0 aborts. Status armId echoes it once taken

variables.name: chMode
variables.description: Average: the 4-receiver mean the DPTF decoder sees. Single: one raw receiver. All: the 4 receivers interleaved

variables.name: preTrigPct
variables.description: Share of the buffer kept from before the trigger, percent

variables.name: missMs
variables.description: Missed trigger: time without a good packet that counts as a miss

variables.name: page
variables.description: Page of the frozen capture to place in AdcCapture_Page
